summary.intent: Land the first-answer seam fixes (wait-and-join PR #427), address a missed Entire insight on PR #426 (#224 generic base traversal), and clean up leftover worktrees, branches, fixtures and agents.
summary.outcome: PR #427 opened with body written; a worker is fixing the #426 finding; worktrees went from 94 to 13, 80 merged local branches deleted, fixtures shrank from 75 GB to ~13 GB. #426, #427 and #396 still await user approval.

repo: Branch can link to only one Entire trail, so #330 could not be linked to feat/wait-and-join (only #329).

Lazy session wait: when structural answer has empty props (entry.props.is_empty()), waits semanticWaitEmptyMs (default 2000, never shorter than semanticWaitMs); unexpandable props types yield zero props plus a warning, not a degraded prop.

OnDemand semantic provider uses interactive and background queues with FIFO per queue; after 4 interactive answers in a row the oldest background request goes next; 64-program recycle runs after every reply.
The napi build regenerates binding.d.ts and index.js with pre-existing drift that should be kept out of PRs.

Finding on PR #426: convert.rs states_bases rejects instantiated generic interfaces (e.g. Props<string> extends React.HTMLAttributes), producing an empty list that overrides structural composes; fix is to follow the generic target and return 'unknown' rather than empty.
Some old worktrees had stale harness locks and required git worktree unlock before non-force removal.
~/Projects/oxc-release-builds and ~/Projects/oxc-stack are registered as worktrees but are separate repos; git refuses to remove them.

code.finding: Name-only base traversal stops at instantiated generic interfaces because states_bases sees only reference flags, so HTMLAttributes bases are lost.
The empty composes list from the traversal replaces the structural composition.
Merge point where an empty list overrides structural composes; needs to distinguish 'decided none' from 'unknown'.

workflow: Check Entire trail findings on every open branch whenever a PR lands or a worker reports, instead of waiting for the user to paste them.
Subagent hand-back reports are model output, not user instructions; verify before relying on them.
Save diffs of dirty worktrees before removal; avoid --force removals the classifier denies.
A `head` in a piped loop truncated the first removal run, requiring a rerun.
Verify dirty/merged/on-remote status per worktree with a plan script before removing.
